acha_height.datum_statement_in_text: none: no attribute of HT states a reference datum in words
acha_height.cf_meaning: CF standard-name table (cfconventions.org current, fetched with curl on 2026-10-17): 'Cloud_top refers to the top of the highest cloud. Geopotential is the sum of the specific gravitational potential energy relative to the geoid and the specific centripetal potential energy. Geopotential height is the geopotential divided by the standard acceleration due to gravity. It is numerically similar to the altitude (or geometric height) and not to the quantity with standard name height, which is relative to the surface.'
acha_height.conclusion: The height is a geopotential height, so it is referenced to the geoid (about sea level) and not to the ground surface. The script does not apply a geoid-to-ellipsoid offset and does not quantify it here. The review's 'unverified' stands for the text, but the standard name answers the open question: not ground.
acha_height.platform_height_for_contrast: nominal_satellite_height 35786.0234375 km, standard_name height_above_reference_ellipsoid (the platform, not the cloud top)

parallax_json_corrections: GOES-East longitude: use -75.0 (grid origin read from the file), not -75.2; -75.2 is the nominal platform subpoint. Effect at most 0.17 km on the Montana table.
GOES-West -137.0 and perspective height 35786023 m: confirmed from file attributes.
Open question 'sea level or ground': HT is geopotential height (geoid), not ground height, so the ground-elevation sensitivity does not apply; the geoid-to-ellipsoid offset is not applied here.
limits: One scan per product and satellite; no time merge; latency is for those files only.
Heights are satellite retrieval estimates of cloud top, not cloud base, damage, hail or a probability. The file's own summary wording was not re-read.
Nearest-neighbour blocks: 0.02 deg cells are finer than the native pixel along the view tilt (4.9 km band 13, 21 to 24 km ACHAC).
CMIPC13 is a brightness temperature (K), not a height; no cloud-base or height claim is made from it.
Only the 10 km ACHAC product is handled; ACHA2KMC is not.
The fixture is synthetic (labelled in its JSON), not NOAA data.
No observed cloud was matched to its true position; this checks the transform and the file, not a drape.

acha2kmc.note: Heights are geopotential cloud-top estimates, not cloud base. The limits list above predates this key.
